about_the_game:
This DLC is BOSS, Literally! We wanted to say a MASSIVE thank you too all of the wonderful early players, kicking butt during the Early Access phase of Neon Abyss 2. Therefore, everyone who has purchased the base game will be able to claim this DLC for free! AND even after the Early Access period ends, you will retain this DLC permanently!

All 34 bosses from the original Neon Abyss have returned! After skill optimizations, visual effects upgrades, and complete reworks of some manager bosses, they've fully evolved! Are you ready to face their wrath?

Please note that some Manager Bosses included in this DLC are still being optimized, but they are on their way! We will continue to polish them throughout the EA phase and add one brand-new manager boss in a future update.

The content list of this DLC:

Manager Bosses (Partially Completed)

  • Argus - God of Darknet ✔

  • Hal - God of Machines ✔

  • Zeus - God of Electricity ✔

  • Dark Zeus - God of Electricity

  • Athena - Goddess of Wisdom

  • Dark Athena - Goddess of Wisdom

  • Ares - God of Violence

  • Dark Ares - God of Violence

  • Titan Prometheus - God of Foresight

  • Titan Kronos - God of Time

  • New Boss
